text:
jin: Quick heads-up — onboarding OREX customer finetune (adapter overlay) hit a small but consistent numeric-format drift when we run the int4 quantized build. sharing quickpack results.
marta: omg ok, details? :eyes:
jin: Short summary — float32 and int8 baselines good. int4 outputs replace `$1,200.00` with `1200.0` or sometimes `1,200` (missing cents). Looks like tokenizer split on thousands separator after quantization/merge.
oliver: customer noticing invoice amounts losing cents in key flows. They flagged it in acceptance tests.
sophia: Is this an adapter merge issue or quantization rounding? What's the repro cost?
jin: Repro commands I ran locally:
```
# run quickpack harness
python tools/eval_quickpack.py --cust orex --adapter overlay-v2 --model base-7b-q4 --quant int4 --tasks invoice-format,dates
```
Result excerpt:
```
task: invoice-format  PASSED: 86/100 (float32)
task: invoice-format  PASSED: 79/100 (int8)
task: invoice-format  PASSED: 62/100 (int4)
example fail: input: "Total: $1,200.00" -> model: "Total: 1200.0"
```
marta: thanks. can you attach a minimal example and tokenizer tokens around the comma? suspect tokenization+kvcache offset.
jin: pasted tokenization snippet:
```
>>> tokenizer.encode("$1,200.00")
[5021, 8, 345, 13, 2201, 5]
>>> tokenizer.decode([5021,8,345,13,2201,5])
"$1,200.00"
```
But after adapter merge + int4 load, the model emits tokens skipping the `13` (comma) in some runs.
oliver: Does adapter overlay change embedding for comma/sep? We did some merges that remap small vocab indices.
marta: Could be subword remap after merge+quant. Two mitigation paths: 1) adjust merge to preserve token ids for punctuation tokens, 2) post-process regex to re-insert cents where numeric patterns match. Pref is fix at merge time.
sophia: Product note — customer wants guaranteed numeric fidelity for billing paths. This can't be a bandaid.
jin: I've opened draft PR with a targeted patch: keep a whitelist of high-frequency punctuation tokens pinned during merge + add an int4 init step that runs short warmstart on example set. PR: https://github.com/redwood/adapter-merges/pull/321
marta: Nice. can we also add a small unit test to quickpack harness to catch missing cents? add pattern check for currency regex and decimal places.
jin: Yep added. eval-bot just posted a smoke run after my patch:
"eval-bot: smoke results for PR 321 — invoice-format int4: 88/100 (was 62/100), token-preserve applied; small regression: one date formatting case; full CI running"
oliver: I'll tell the customer we've got a fix and will run dedicated smoke on their dataset. ETA?
jin: planning a dedicated run this afternoon; if CI green i'll ship canary to Dedicated pool and ask them to validate. ETA ~6h.
sophia: thanks team. assign follow-ups:
- jin -> finalize PR + canary deploy
- marta -> add quickpack unit test + docs note
- oliver -> coordinate customer validation window
- eval-bot -> run nightly regression with currency checks
marta: logging thread into onboarding tracker: https://redwood-prod.atlassian.com/browse/ONB-788 :thumbsup:
jin: will post canary logs here once deployed. :rocket:
